baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative chain نَزَّلْنَا ... فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ and its paired outputs جَنَّٰتٍ and حَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Water is deliberately conveyed from above, bears stable increasing good, and is made the instrument that differentiates into enclosing perennial gardens and grain ready for cutting. The verse is a staged provisioning process, not a loose inventory of pleasant objects.

activation_trace.role: The branch image of bringing something down and delivering it supplies the initiating transfer in the causal chain.
The overhead sky, cloud, and rain image supplies the elevated source from which the transfer proceeds.
The image of conveying water by watering or pouring makes water the usable medium rather than scenery.
The image of fixed, growing good explains why the delivered water continues into multiplied benefit.
The image of an agent causing planting and growth supplies the productive conversion from water to vegetation.
The tree-screened garden supplies the durable, enclosing output of the process.
The germinating grain image supplies the compact, edible output that can reproduce.
The cutting of ripe crop supplies the process endpoint and marks benefit as harvestable.

changed_reading.before: Beneficial rain makes gardens and grain.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately delivered medium carries durable increase through a causative production sequence into two complementary forms of usable yield.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The compact unit مَآءً مُّبَٰرَكًا and the instrumental بِهِۦ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch cluster allows blessing to be read hydrologically: water appears and accumulates, is held rather than lost at once, and thereby keeps generating growth. This does not replace the evaluative sense of blessedness; it gives that evaluation a material mechanism of retention plus increase.

activation_trace.role: The image of land visibly registering descent or rapid runoff supplies the receiving terrain where rain leaves an effect.
The image of water appearing, entering, and becoming plentiful supplies accumulation in the receiving environment.
The fixed water in a basin supplies retention as one material face of blessing.
The fixed and increasing good supplies the move from retained water to continuing productivity.
The plant emerging from earth supplies the observable release of the retained benefit.

changed_reading.before: Blessed is a general honorific attached to rainwater.
changed_reading.after: Blessing names a materially durable efficacy: water stays, accumulates, and releases its increase as growth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from أَنۢبَتْنَا through جَنَّٰتٍ, حَبَّ, and حَصِيدِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus words can be arranged temporally: a compact seed holds latent growth, emergence produces covering vegetation, and cutting at maturity returns abundance to concentrated grain. Concealment here is productive latency rather than absence.

activation_trace.role: The seed that germinates and bears grain supplies the compact latent unit at both ends of the cycle.
The emergence of vegetation from earth supplies the transition from latency to visible life.
The image of covering and concealment supplies productive hiddenness within the growth cycle.
Dense, rising, interwoven vegetation supplies the mature expansion of what began hidden.
Cutting the mature crop supplies the temporal closure that recovers grain from growth.

changed_reading.before: Gardens and harvested grain are parallel products.
changed_reading.after: They also expose phases of a cycle in which hidden potential emerges, thickens, matures, and is gathered back into seed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth's apparent subtraction is set beside joining or inscribing and guarding. When this precedes the focus cycle of concealed grain emerging into organized growth, decomposition can be read as tracked dispersal rather than irreversible loss; the agricultural cycle becomes an image of recoverable form.

activation_trace.role: The germinating seed supplies a small latent unit from which organized form can return.
Concealment supplies the state in which recoverable potential is present but not visible.
Emergence from earth supplies the visible reconstitution phase.
The loss of part of a thing supplies the problem of bodies apparently diminished by earth.
The joining of one thing to another supplies a branch-level image for organized recomposition.
A fixed inscription or determination supplies the durable account against which apparent loss is measured.
Guarding and preserving supplies continuity across the period of earthly concealment.

structural_cues: 50:3-4 poses return after death, names what earth diminishes, and immediately asserts a preserving book before the growth demonstration of 50:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies diminution, joining or inscription, preservation, hidden grain, and regrowth; I supply the arrow from preserved account to reconstitution. A live alternative is that the book guarantees exhaustive knowledge without functioning as a material template.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts a repeatable plant cycle.
changed_reading.after: The cycle answers the fear of earthly loss: dispersed, hidden units remain knowable and recoverable into organized life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same water-led sequence is explicitly continued into enlivening dead land and خروج, then the surah closes with earth splitting open. The focus therefore supplies the operational middle term of the resurrection comparison: concealed inertness receives an enabling medium, rises into life, and exits its cover.

activation_trace.role: Water conveyed by watering supplies the enabling medium in the reanimation sequence.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the observable transition from inert concealment to life.
Concealment supplies the covered state from which life appears.
Dead land and lifeless matter supply the inert starting state explicitly attached to the focus's water.
The life of earth through rain and plants directly names the focus process as reanimation.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the resurrection-side result of the growth process.
Earth splitting and opening supplies the final physical release from the covering medium.

structural_cues: 50:11 repeats بِهِۦ, declares the town dead then enlivened, and says كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ.
50:42 repeats يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ, while 50:44 renders earth opening and people emerging rapidly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the explicit analogy, the repeated instrumental pronoun, dead land, enlivening, خروج, and opened earth; I identify 50:9's germination as the mechanism that makes the analogy intelligible. The narrower alternative is that only 50:11's revived town, not every noun in 50:9, bears the comparison.

changed_reading.after: It stages a visible mechanism of reanimation and emergence that the surah applies to bodily خروج.

context_deltas.mechanism: A non-dominant mapping of س م و activates the first rain as a mark that writes vegetation onto earth. The surrounding commands to see and remember, followed later by lifting a cover and sharpening sight, turn the focus's movement from concealed growth to visible growth into an epistemic event: the terrain becomes a legible disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The branch image of first rain marking earth with vegetation supplies botanical inscription from the focus's sky term.
Concealment supplies what must become perceptible for the mark to disclose anything.
Emergent vegetation supplies the visible script left by rain on earth.
Insight of the heart supplies the receptive act by which the visible growth becomes more than scenery.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the cognitive effect assigned to the preceding created scene.
Lifting a cover supplies the later disclosure pattern that sharpens the focus's concealment-to-appearance movement.
The covering veil supplies the obstruction whose removal turns latent truth into sharp sight.

structural_cues: 50:6-8 directs looking across sky and earth and labels the scene تبصرة and ذكرى immediately before the focus ayah.
50:22 repeats the visual structure as cover removed and sight made sharp.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain-as-mark, concealment, visible emergence, insight, reminder, covering, and disclosure; I supply the arrow that treats vegetation as an inscription read by the observer. A live alternative is the simpler claim that growth is evidence without being conceptualized as writing or marking.

changed_reading.before: Rain produces a scene that may be observed.
changed_reading.after: Rain makes earth bear a readable vegetal mark, converting hidden efficacy into a disclosure meant to alter perception and memory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's descent can activate نُزُل as provision prepared for an arriving guest. The immediate naming of the produce as apportioned sustenance, followed later by the garden brought near and entered in peace, lets worldly rainfall function as advance hospitality and as a small-scale preview of welcomed provision.

activation_trace.role: Prepared food and provision for a guest supplies the hospitality image latent in the act of descent.
Fixed, increasing good supplies the beneficent quality of the offered provision.
The tree-screened garden supplies both the present food-producing place and the destination echo.
The apportioned gift directly classifies the focus's gardens, grain, and dates as provision for recipients.
Rain descending as provision closes the material link between the delivered water and the prepared yield.
Movement into nearness supplies the gesture of provision or destination being brought toward its guests.
Entry into an interior supplies the arriving-guest side of the hospitality model.
Safety and freedom from harm supply the condition of welcome under which entry occurs.

structural_cues: 50:9-11 runs without a break from descending water through gardens, grain, and ordered dates to رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ.
50:31-35 brings the garden near, commands peaceful entry, and promises desired provision plus increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the نُزُل branch, named provision, nearness, entry, safety, and garden repetition; I supply the hospitality arc linking present rain to later welcome. The materially live alternative is that نَزَّلْ is only ordinary causative descent and the worldly gardens need not preview the eschatological singular garden.

changed_reading.before: The water is sent down to supply crops.
changed_reading.after: The descent also resembles provision laid out in advance for recipients who are invited toward a garden and welcomed into safety.

context_deltas.mechanism: Blessing increases, but the focus terminates in harvest and the adjacent dates are arranged in layers. Later, one destination asks whether there is still more after filling while the other receives promised increase. These repetitions activate a distinction between ordered, ripened surplus and appetite that treats every fullness as a demand for more.

activation_trace.role: Stable increase in good supplies abundance as productive blessing rather than quantity alone.
Cutting at ripeness supplies a boundary and usable culmination for increase.
Things joined in orderly arrangement supply form and measure to the immediately adjacent abundance.
Fullness matching a container supplies the later image of a capacity that nevertheless voices further demand.
Increase supplies the demanded more that follows the question of fullness.
Increase supplies the answering surplus promised beyond fulfilled desire in the garden.

structural_cues: 50:10 immediately extends the focus with date clusters described as نَّضِيدٌ.
50:30 and 50:35 place two uses of مَّزِيدٍ around opposed destinations, one demanded after fullness and one held as gift.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stable increase, harvest boundary, ordered stacking, container-fullness, and two later instances of more; I supply the contrast between fruitful surplus and insatiable demand. The repetitions may instead be local rhetoric that does not redefine the blessing of 50:9.

changed_reading.before: Blessed water means greater agricultural quantity.
changed_reading.after: Its increase is shaped, matured, and made receivable, anticipating the surah's contrast between gifted surplus and demand that no fullness closes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The residue-after-harvest branch of ح ش ر is surprising because it is a lexical byway, not the ordinary gloss of حَشْرٌ in 50:44. It remains anchored by the focus's explicit harvest term and by the closing sequence of earth splitting followed by collective gathering. Downstream prose should present this only as a branch resonance that makes the final gathering resemble collection after harvest, never as a replacement translation or a claim that persons are literally crop residue.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ in 50:9, reactivated by تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ and حَشْرٌ in 50:44.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and gathering ripe crop supplies the explicit harvest anchor in the focus.
Earth splitting open supplies the release of what had been covered before collection.
Driving and collecting a group toward one destination supplies the primary gathering mechanism.
Crop remainder after harvest supplies the odd but traceable echo back to the focus's harvest endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Harvest in 50:9 marks food becoming ready for use.
changed_reading.after: The final earth-opening and gathering can faintly reactivate that harvest as a model of collective extraction and collection after concealment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The comparison between planted covering and moral covering is surprising because it crosses from an agricultural branch of ك ف ر to the contextual person named كَفَّار. It remains anchored in the focus's hidden seed, growth, and increasing good, while 50:24-25 joins covering-denial to withholding beneficial good. Downstream prose should frame this as a contrastive mechanism: one covering protects latency until emergence, whereas the other blocks truth and circulation of good; it must not gloss disbelief as seed planting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The concealed grain, caused growth, and fixed increase of حَبَّ, أَنۢبَتْنَا, and مُّبَٰرَكًا.

activation_trace.role: The grain that germinates supplies a unit whose initial covering can be productively released.
Growth emerging from earth supplies the successful passage beyond covering.
Fixed and increasing good supplies what productive circulation yields.
Covering and concealment supplies the broad action that can become obstructive in the moral context.
Covering seed supplies the cross-domain hinge back to the focus's grain, while remaining branch-distant from the contextual usage.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the blockage of beneficial circulation.
Beneficial good supplies what the withholding blocks and the blessed water multiplies.

changed_reading.before: The focus's covered seed and growth are morally neutral agricultural processes.
changed_reading.after: They can support a contained contrast between concealment that incubates and releases good and covering-withholding that arrests good before it can circulate.

strongest_changes: The rain-growth chain becomes the surah's operational model for reanimation and خروج.
Earthly diminution is reframed as preserved, recoverable dispersal rather than terminal loss.
A split س م و to و س م branch turns vegetation into a visible mark that trains sight and remembrance.
Blessed abundance gains structure: retention, ordered maturation, harvest boundary, and apportioned provision.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made two low-salience branch activations unusually productive: first rain marking earth with vegetation through the non-dominant و س م mapping, and ح ش ر as post-harvest remainder beside the final gathering. It also kept the hospitality branch of ن ز ل live without forcing it over the ordinary descent reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The explicit resurrection comparison securely reaches revived land, but its extension to every focus noun is reconstructed rather than stated.
The inscription, hospitality, bounded-abundance, and productive-covering models depend on branch resonance and should remain qualified.
The preserved book may guarantee knowledge and decree without implying a reassembly template.
